title: Report store file helpers
responsibility: Resolves the report root, validates identifiers and reads or atomically replaces JSON files.

inputs.name: reportFiles.root
inputs.description: Optional root override; empty falls through to environment and then the user-home default.

inputs.name: safeId.id
inputs.description: Identifier containing only ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, from one to 100 characters.

outputs.name: reportFiles
outputs.description: Explicit root, PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME, or the project-reports directory under the user’s Codex home folder.

outputs.name: readJson
outputs.description: Promise resolving to parsed JSON cast to the requested type, without runtime shape validation.

outputs.name: atomicJson
outputs.description: Promise that creates parent directories, writes formatted JSON to a UUID-suffixed temporary file and renames it over the destination.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid identifiers throw Invalid report or asset ID. Read, parse, serialization and filesystem failures propagate.
